patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Closely share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than Closely's shape. Choose Closely only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn + email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and white-label ” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans data-enrichment, contact-management; Closely leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Closely share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; Closely is LinkedIn + email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and white-label options for agencies..
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning data-enrichment, contact-management vs Closely-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; Closely — Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record..

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; Closely: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record.; Plans are gated by LinkedIn sender seats and enrichment/AI credit bundles..

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · Closely is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record. · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need Closely's motion (LinkedIn + email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and wh)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
